title: アカデミックプレゼンテーション
subtitle: Academic Presentation
educationalGoal:
In this subject you will acquire presentation skills in English. The learning goals are as follows

(1) Learn the format and structure of the academic presentation.
(2) Learn linguistic expressions used in presentations (eg, descriptions of figures, tables, graphs, data, etc.).
(3) Learn how to create presentation materials and manuscripts.
advice:
This course is a presentation skills course. We will cover the following materials:

1. English Presentation Basics.
2. Structure and Flow of Academic English Presentation.
3. Digital Presentation.

Students are required to actively participate in the class.
requiredKnowledge:
Computer literacy skills such as presentation software.
It is recommended that prospective graduate students and Boeing Externship students take this course.

activityGoals.body: Understand the structure of academic presentations.
Can logically present information in English.
Give presentations using non-linguistics and linguistic English expressions.
Create clear and accurate presentation materials incorporating images, figures, tables and graphs.
Create and deliver presentation materials using a computer.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Can fully understand the format and structure of the presentation, and use them to make logical presentations in English.
(2) Can give logical and clear presentations using non-linguistic and linguistic English expressions (including accurate explanations of figures, tables, graphs and data).
(3) Create clear and accurate presentation materials incorporating images, figures, tables and graphs.
(4) Create and deliver presentation materials using a computer.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Can understand the format and structure of the presentation, and use them to make logical presentations in English.
(2) Can give presentations using non-linguistic and linguistic English expressions (including accurate explanations of figures, tables, graphs and data).
(3) Create presentation materials incorporating images, figures, tables and graphs.
(4) Create and deliver presentation materials using a computer.
